title: Positive or Negative
description: Classify numbers as positive, negative, or zero, and process arrays of numbers.

steps.title: Check if positive
steps.description: Write an `isPositive` function that returns `true` if a number is greater than zero.
hints: A number is positive if it's greater than 0

verification.successMessage: 5 is positive, -3 is not, 0 is not!
verification.failureMessage: isPositive(5) should be true, isPositive(-3) and isPositive(0) should be false.

steps.title: Check if negative
steps.description: Write an `isNegative` function that returns `true` if a number is less than zero.
hints: A number is negative if it's less than 0

verification.failureMessage: isNegative(-3) should be true, isNegative(5) and isNegative(0) should be false.

steps.title: Classify a number
steps.description: Write a `classifyNumber` function that returns `"positive"`, `"negative"`, or `"zero"` based on the input.

steps.title: Classify an array
steps.description: Write a `classifyArray` function that takes an array of numbers and returns an array of their classifications.
hints: Use .map() in JS/TS or a list comprehension in Python

steps.title: Count positives, negatives, zeros
steps.description: Write a function that counts how many positive, negative, and zero numbers are in an array, returning an object.
hints: Use if/else or your classifyNumber to determine each
Return { positive: count, negative: count, zero: count }

verification.failureMessage: The object should have positive, negative, and zero counts.
